resources.string: Uses the measured profile for this game and device when available. Calibration compares real FPS and frame pacing from one checkpoint. The initial fallback is 1×, FXAA off, bilinear, up to 120 FPS. Manual graphics values below are kept and apply again when Auto is off.
The automatic state could not be saved. The previous state is kept. Leave the game without saving?
1×, FXAA off, bilinear, 30 FPS. Apply at the next game start.
Volume and mute apply on resume. Buffering and HRTF apply at the next game start. Smaller buffers can crackle when the device is busy.
Framing and display options apply when returning to the game. Cropping changes the visible picture, not the game’s rendering resolution.
Save state when leaving the game
Creates a separate automatic slot on normal exit. Manual slots are kept. Does not run after a crash or forced stop.
When launching from the library, offer the existing automatic slot before starting a new session.
Warns at your chosen thresholds. CPU/SoC and battery sensors are separate. Does not change system clocks.
Temperature threshold reached: %1$s. Consider a lower render scale or FPS limit.
Hold Select, then press the assigned button. Each combination has one action. Quick and automatic slots are separate from manual slots.
No quick state has been saved for this game.
An automatic state is available. Resume it or start the game normally?
Export this scope to copy its settings to another game or device. Import replaces settings in this scope; games, drivers, controls and saves are not included. Reopen this screen after importing.
